name: Maribor circular economy pilot sites
zag_role: Demonstration of secondary raw materials in urban construction and urban soil
description: CINDERELA, coordinated by ZAG, established a pilot production plant for construction products from waste in Maribor, planned a one storey demonstration building made with recycled aggregates and recycled soil, and carried out preliminary geotechnical investigation for revitalising a degraded area. URBAN SOIL 4 FOOD, an Urban Innovative Actions project led by the City of Maribor with ZAG as a partner, tested a pilot system for producing certified urban soil from city waste and used it in community gardens.
history: Maribor hosted Slovenian pilots of two circular economy projects in which ZAG took part. The CINDERELA pilots cover production of construction products from non-hazardous construction and other waste, a demonstration building with green concrete and recycled aggregates, and geotechnical works with secondary raw materials on a degraded area. The URBAN SOIL 4 FOOD project used excavated materials and biological waste from the city to produce standardised soil for urban gardens.
facts: one storey, green concrete with recycled aggregates

source_differences: Record years 2017-2022: CINDERELA ran 1 Jun 2018 - 30 Nov 2022 (CORDIS), Urban Soil 4 Food was scheduled to end Nov 2020 (EC Regio).
Record says 'more than 7,000 m2' of urban gardens planned, EC Regio says the urban gardens are on a 12,400 m2 plot (66 plots in the first garden).
CORDIS does not say the CINDERELA Slovenian demos were in Maribor, it lists Maribor partners Nigrad (Zagrebška cesta 30) and RRA Podravje.
Project end: the ZAG project list gives 31 May 2021 for CINDERELA, the record sheet gives 30 November 2022.
